title: Why Being Too Nice Kills Your Influence – Machiavelli
description: Being agreeable feels safe, but it can train people to discount you. This episode breaks down the warmth-without-status trap, using Machiavelli and modern social psychology to show how boundaries, calm disagreement, and strategic scarcity restore respect. You'll get scripts to stop over-explaining and become influential without becoming cold.

title: If You're Arrogant Than Everyone Else, Watch This - Schopenhauer
